release_boundary.note: The enclosing tag includes the earlier withdrawal-destination wire update; the constraints above apply only to this publication-reliability workstream.

evidence_scope.local_harness: one host, one loopback RPC, two process/key scopes

proposals.title: Node-informed bounded fee and RBF controller
invariants: participant-signed state bytes remain unchanged across fee attempts
the initial carrier fee converges against the final rebuilt serialized size before broadcast
fee never exceeds sponsor-script or operator-policy caps
replacement fee is at least the node-reported min_replace_fee
the runtime deadline deducts observed confirmations and preserves reorg, failover, safety, and canonical-confirmation budgets
every attempt is durably attributable to an operator and publication intent

proposals.title: Measured challenge-window gate
invariants: configured challenge window is not shorter than the measured latency budget
reorg, confirmation, failover, and safety margins are explicit
insufficient or stale measurements fail closed for production profiles
the window uses the maximum of overall and per-fault-family P99.9 latency
an operator-supplied SHA-256 binds the decision to exact dataset bytes without claiming provenance

proposals.title: Induced reorg and delay rehearsal
invariants: orphaned cursor context is cleared
rescan begins at or before channel creation
publication outcome is reconciled against canonical StateCell state
mempool eviction without a reorg cannot strand an intent behind an advanced cursor

proposals.title: Two independent least-privilege watchtower operators
invariants: watchtower publication does not require participant private keys
local operators have distinct identities, keys, sponsor budgets, cursors, stores, profiles, and attempt logs
production additionally requires independent RPCs, hosts, administration, health and alert sinks, and receipts
duplicate publication is idempotent and safe under StateCell single-spend

proposals.title: Adversarial mempool and RBF acceptance matrix
invariants: below-floor publication is rejected
insufficient replacement is rejected
valid higher-fee replacement commits
the replaced transaction is reported as RBFRejected
the canonical successor contains the intended latest signed state
duplicate rebroadcast is reconciled by deterministic transaction hash
